subject: Sign-off: Sr Software Engineer offer — comp package

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sign-off request: Sr Software Engineer (Alex Romero) — comp package

Hi Laura / Markus,

Candidate: Alex Romero (phone: +1-415-555-0134)
Role: Senior Software Engineer, Platform (L5)
Recruiter: Renee Dawson (TalentWise)

We need final sign-off on the offer comp package so People Ops can issue the letter. Summary below — attaching the term sheet and comp band reference.

Proposed package (total cash / equity / notes):
- Base salary: $180,000
- Target bonus: 12% (performance)
- Equity: 0.40% RSU vesting 4y / 1y cliff (converted to dollar value at RFC pricing)
- Signing bonus: $20,000 (one-time) — requested by candidate to bridge notice period

Rationale and context:
- Candidate has 8 years infra/ML systems experience, two prior roles at scale-ups and strong DB/serving background. Hiring team recommends at midpoint-plus for L5 to secure acceptance without over-indexing L6 comp.
- Total cash is slightly above the L5 midpoint but within the hiring manager discretionary buffer for mission-critical hires.

Ask: Laura/Markus please confirm one of the following by EOD tomorrow so we can prepare the DocuSign envelope:
1) Approve as-is
2) Approve with equity adjusted to 0.35%
3) Request changes to base/bonus (please specify)

Notes: Finance confirmed ongoing budget for this headcount and Marissa is CC'ed for compensation ops. If you want to escalate to compensation committee, flag here and I will set up a 15-min sync.

Attachments: AlexRomero_OfferTermSheet_v1.pdf, comp-band-L5.pdf

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0167
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sign-off request: Sr Software Engineer (Alex Romero) — comp package

Thanks for the summary, Sofia.

Approve with one small change: reduce equity to 0.35% (option B from your note). The base and signing bonus look fine to me. My rationale: strong candidate but does not have prior direct L5 leadership; equity a touch high against recent comps we've granted for similar backgrounds.

If Laura is aligned, please proceed. If we need to sweeten beyond that later (retention risk), we can add a performance-based RSU refresh at 12 months.

Markus — thanks for the quick read. I agree with option 2.

Final decision: approve with equity set to 0.35%. Keep base at $180k, bonus 12%, signing bonus $20k.

Two operational notes before you send:
- Please ensure offer language includes the standard clause about Buyout/recruiter fee reimbursements (Renee's placement).
- If candidate counters on base, we can consider moving 10% of the signing bonus into additional base but only with documented business case.

Sofia — you have final sign-off to proceed and send the offer. Marissa, please confirm DocuSign envelope template (L5) is used and that finance will code the signing bonus to the hiring manager's recruiting budget.
